sottotitolo: Fresh, exports from Norway; Italian imports
titolo_pagina: Salmon price: weekly quotations and imports into Italy
descrizione_pagina: Weekly average export price of Norwegian salmon in euro, volumes, five-year seasonal position and Italian imports. Sources disclosed, updated weekly.

domande.domanda: Is this price high for the time of year?
domande.risposta: The band at the top compares the week with the same weeks of the previous five years.

domande.domanda: Is this the price my supplier is asking?
domande.risposta: No. It is the average export value from Norway, across all sizes and destinations. It serves as a trend reference, not as a contractual quotation.

domande.domanda: How much of it reaches Italy?
domande.risposta: The flows panel shows monthly Italian imports and the rolling twelve-month total.

domande.domanda: Why is Norway not among the origins?
domande.risposta: Because Norwegian salmon enters the Union through other countries, mainly Nordic ones, and reaches Italy from there as intra-EU trade. Statistics record the country of dispatch, not the country of farming.

serie.presentazione: Whole, not specified by the source
serie.elaborazione: None on the value. Euro conversion calculated separately.
serie.note: Average across all sizes and destinations. Not a contractual quotation: the reference used in European physical contracts is the exporter-panel spot index, today SISALMONI.

stagionale.lettura: In line with the usual values for this time of year.

stagionale_al_netto.lettura: In line with the usual values for this time of year.

flussi.note: The importing Member State is often the customs point of entry, not the final destination. The customs value includes transport to the border.

bollettino.titolo: Movement against the usual pattern for the period
bollettino.testo: In week 46 the price is down 1.5%. In the same weeks of the previous 5 years the average movement was up 3.3%. Worth checking with operators whether this reflects availability, demand or a one-off event.

bollettino.titolo: The move in euro is not a market move
bollettino.testo: In the source currency the price is up 0.1%; in euro it is down 1.5%. The difference comes from the exchange rate. For euro buyers the second figure is what counts, but a negotiation with a supplier who thinks in local currency starts from the first.

bollettino.titolo: Atlantic salmon: seasonal position has changed
bollettino.testo: Four weeks ago the price sat in the upper band of the values recorded at this time of year; it now sits in the middle band (percentile 64 over 25 observations from 2021-2025). This is the shift that matters when deciding whether to bring forward or postpone a purchase.

This week's quantities (26,669 tonnes) are above almost all values for the same weeks in recent years (usual range 22,141 to 25,749 tonnes). A volume anomaly often leads the price of the following weeks.

lede: Salmon exported from Norway closes week 46 at €6.94/kg, slightly down 1.5% on the week. Against the same period of 2025 the price is 1.2% higher. For mid-November it is a normal level. Volumes, 26,669 tonnes, are among the highest for the period. Over the last twelve months Italy imported 65,379 tonnes, 74% of it from Sweden, up 6% on the previous twelve.
